input: Any commit that modifies /moves/queen_d8.text or /moves/king_e8.text, or any /moves/<agent>.text path, must also modify /turn/ply.num, and must be co-signed by at least fourteen of the sixteen Black agents' keys in addition to the moving piece's own key, so that repeated off-plan moves from any single agent such as queen_d8 can never be accepted without near-unanimous agreement.
response: always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -modifies(/turn/ply.num)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/$k.id)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -threshold("14", /team/pieces)] false)
